lines: Good morning, what brings you in today?
I've had a fever for three days and a dry cough.
Any chest pain or breathlessness?
No chest pain, but I feel very tired.
Are you taking anything for it?
I took paracetamol 500 milligrams twice a day.
Any allergies?
I'm allergic to penicillin.
Your temperature is 38.6 and your pulse is 96. Your chest is clear on listening.
This looks like a viral upper respiratory infection.
Continue paracetamol, drink plenty of fluids, and come back if you become breathless.
Hello, how have your sugars been?
Not good, doctor. My fasting sugar has been around 220 most mornings.
Are you taking your metformin?
Yes, metformin 500 milligrams twice a day, every day.
Any tingling or numbness in your feet?
No tingling at all.
Any problems with your eyesight?
No, my eyes are fine.
Your blood pressure today is 142 over 88 and your weight is 84 kilos.
Your diabetes is not well controlled on the current dose.
I am increasing metformin to 1000 milligrams twice a day and ordering an HbA1c test.
Let's review you again in three months.
What seems to be the problem today?
My son has had loose stools for two days, about six times a day.
Is there any blood in the stool?
No blood. He vomited once this morning.
Is he drinking and passing urine?
He is drinking water and he passed urine two hours ago.
Any fever?
He felt a bit warm last night.
His temperature is 37.9 and he looks mildly dehydrated; his tummy is soft and not tender.
This looks like acute gastroenteritis with mild dehydration.
Give him oral rehydration solution after every loose stool and zinc tablets for ten days.
Come back straight away if he has no urine for eight hours or becomes very drowsy.
Tell me about the back pain.
It started last week after I lifted a heavy box at work.
Does the pain go anywhere?
Yes, it shoots down my left leg.
Any numbness, weakness or problems passing urine?
No numbness and no bladder problems.
What have you taken for it?
Ibuprofen 400 milligrams helps a little.
On examination there is tenderness over the lower lumbar spine and straight leg raise is positive on the left at 40 degrees.
This is most likely sciatica from a disc problem.
I'll refer you for physiotherapy and change the ibuprofen to naproxen 500 milligrams twice a day with food.
Review in two weeks, sooner if you get numbness or bladder problems.
How is your breathing?
I've been wheezing most nights for the past month.
How often are you using your salbutamol inhaler?
About four times a day now.
Do you smoke?
Yes, about ten cigarettes a day.
Any allergies to medicines?
Aspirin makes my breathing worse.
I can hear wheeze on both sides of your chest and your oxygen saturation is 95 percent.
Your asthma is poorly controlled.
I'm starting a budesonide formoterol inhaler twice a day, and I strongly advise you to stop smoking; we can refer you to the stop smoking service.
I'd like to see you again in four weeks.
